name: claude-code-kit
description: Skills, mods and hooks for Claude Code that work on macOS, Linux and Windows. The parts that need setup (pr-watch, reminders, the email guard, the sync) install with install.sh instead.

plugins.name: capability-builder
plugins.description: Turns a request you keep making into a skill, hook or mod, with tests, checked on macOS, Linux and Windows.

plugins.name: test-evidence
plugins.description: Screenshots, a short video and network proof of a ticket tested locally, attached to Jira or the PR (needs the chrome-devtools MCP).

plugins.name: ci-review
plugins.description: An AI review step on CI that checks each PR/MR against the proof it carries (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI).

plugins.name: file-tools-guard
plugins.description: Blocks shell workarounds (cat, sed -i, heredocs) for reading and editing files, so Claude uses its own file tools.

plugins.name: paste-preview
plugins.description: Pasted text shown in full, and previews of pasted images (macOS, Windows).

plugins.name: recent-prompts
plugins.description: Your last two messages above the prompt, and a searchable history pane (/prompts).

plugins.name: learn
plugins.description: Short, precise lessons on the security, architecture or patterns behind the code at hand, at the end of a reply. /learn off|brief|normal|deep per session.
